questions.question:
The scores of seven batsman B1, B2, B3, B4, B5, B6 and B7 are compared. The score of B1 is greater than B7 and B3. The score of B6 is neither more nor less than the score of B4 but more than B1. B5 scored less than only one batsman. The score of B7 is not the least score.

How many batsman scored more than B4?
questions.solution:
Step 1: The score of B1 is greater than B7 and B3.

 **B1 > B7 > B3**

Step 2: The score of B6 is neither more nor less than the score of B4 but more than B1.

 **B6 = B4 > B1**

Step 3: The score of B7 is not the least score.</p

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. All M are Q.

II. No L is Q.

**Conclusions:**

I. No M is L.

II. Some L are not M.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
From the given information, the Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4043744be5c909a44ae22d1c87f06211c99a6850f5908c40c8659161cd56cdd.png] 

**I. No M is L: **According to the statements, no L is Q and all M are Q which can be stated as no M is L. Thus the conclusion follows. 

**II. Some L are not M : **Since no M is L, it is safe to say that some L are not M. Thus the conclusion follows. 

**Both the conclusion follows.**

**Hence the correct answer is option 2.**

questions.question:

Cricket : Bat :: Hockey : Stick :: Rugby : ?
questions.solution:
The relation used i the given series is:

 **The game : The essential object used to play that game**

__Cricket : Bat__ -- **Cricket** is played with the help of a **bat**.

__Hockey : Stick__ -- **Hockey** is played with the help of a **stick**.

__Rugby : ?__ -- **Rugby** is played with the help of a **ball**.

Hence **the correct answer is option 1)**

questions.question:

7 : 2401 :: 3 : 441 :: 5 : ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

 **(First term)² × 7² = Second term**

Now we apply the pattern on the series:

__7 : 2401__ :: 3 : 441 :: 5 : ?

 (First term)2 × 72 = Second term

(7)² × 7² = 2401

__**49 × 49**__ = 2401 

2401 = 2401

7 : 2401 :: __3 : 441__ :: 5 : ?

 (First term)2 × 72 = Second term

(3)2 × 72 = 441

__**9 × 49**__ = 441

441 = 441

7 : 2401 :: 3 : 441 :: __5 : ?__

 (First term)2 × 72 = Second term

(5)2 × 72 = Answer

**25 × 49** = Answer

**1225 = Answer**

**Hence the correct answer is option 4.**

questions.question:
After interchanging the given two signs, what will be the value of the given expression?

÷ and × 

5 + 10 ÷ 8 × 2 - 20
questions.solution:
When we interchange ÷ and × and solve the equation using BODMAS rule, we get:**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94a3ba98fe537b71a0cedca8cdf679aea0668b950fa8b6ddc2ea6c6e99a6adff.png] 

**5 + 10 ÷ 8 ****×**** 2 - 20**

5 + 10 × __**8 ÷ 2**__ - 20

5 + __**10 **____**× **4__ - 20

__**5 + **____40__** - 20

__**45 - 20**__ 

Answer = **25** 

**Hence the correct answer is option 1.**

 some scales are erasers is not correct. Thus conclusion does not follow. 

**II: Some pencils are scales: **Since 'all scales are pencils' it is safe to say that some pencils are scales. So the conclusion follows.

**Only conclusion II follows.**

Hence **the correct answer option 2)**

questions.question:
Seven girls V, K, L, P, A, C and N are sitting in a row facing the South (not necessarily in the same order). L is to the immediate left of P. K is at the rightmost end. A is the immediate neighbour of K. Only N is between A and C. Only P is between L and C. Which of the following statements is/are correct?

I. P is third to the left of A.

II. N is to the immediate right of C.
questions.solution:
All of them are facing south,

Step 1: K is at the righttmost end.

Step 2: A is the immediate neighbour of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b735c354e03b0c77c78c0255174e58ccab645433f7ee88bdc2ee94a18c2cf2f.png] 

Step 3: Only N is between A and C. 

Step 4: Only P is between L and C.

Step 5: L is to the immediate left of P.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6c85ed2174484c65fe2ba5ed82bba6897e45299f440a8b70699ce25c976c7ef.png] 

The only girl left is V and there is only 1 spot left.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cad8e981b87055fedb8c75852fb77baf7b63ae69ca05b5d43713c64cec9d85d9.png] 

Now according to the diagram, we check the statements:

I. P is third to the left of A: **True.** 

II. N is to the immediate right of C: **True. **

Both statements are true.

**Hence the correct answer is option 3.**
